'''2026 Retro Worlds Will Tarbox DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Will Tarbox]] at the [[2026 Retro World Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Will Tarbox]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Retro World Championship]]
